chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, raising it, said:

When Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) was washed, they were called from the side of the house: 'If you take the front of the bier, you will be sufficed regarding its rear; and if you take its rear, you will be sufficed regarding its front.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali (عليه السلام), Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.جَانِبِ الْبَيْتِ: the side of the house from which the call was heard
key_terms.كُفِيتُمْ: you would be spared or sufficed from carrying
key_terms.مُقَدَّمَ السَّرِيرِ: the front part of the bier

ai.seo_question: What happened when Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) was washed for burial?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an extraordinary event during the washing and funeral handling of Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام). A call from the side of the house informed those present that unseen assistance would carry whichever end of the bier they did not hold, indicating a miraculous honor associated with him.
